AccountEpoch.description: Unique identifier for one authenticated account session epoch.

AccountHandoffGoal.description: The account change a client asks the user to make in the player.

oneOf.description: The account already satisfies the goal; nothing was asked of the user.
Shown in the player's activity view; the user signs in there. No window is opened.
The requested account change was observed in the player.

AccountScope.description: Redacted local scope identifier isolating accounts in cache/state.

uiLanguage.description: Settings saved before the UI language existed load as English.

audioMode.description: Song or video variant selected in the official page.

qualityLabel.description: Opaque playback-quality label reported by the page, not a measured audio bit rate.

BridgeEpoch.description: Unique identifier for one authorized page bridge handshake.

BrowseId.description: Opaque YouTube Music browse endpoint identifier.

listenerActions.description:
What the listener did by hand in the last ten minutes, newest first, at most
[`crate::MAX_LISTENER_ACTIONS`]. Commands sent by agents are not listed.

moment.description: Owner-configured Moment DJ context projected for this client (`None` only in legacy fixtures).

ControlRequest.description: Application protocol over the local control socket.

oneOf.description: Returns the next prompt for a DJ agent, if any; polled by the MCP adapter while it waits.
The listener's own music in brief: liked songs, playlists, plays and their scripts.

CoreEpoch.description: Unique identifier for one Rust core process instance.

DjChattiness.description: How often the heartbeat lets the agent check in with the listener.

DjCue.description: One prompt for the agent, with the listening context as it is at delivery.

coreEpoch.description: Core epoch of the running daemon so background waiters can scope `(coreEpoch, seq)` safely.

moment.description: Moment DJ snapshot computed freshly when this prompt is delivered.

officialUpNext.description:
What YouTube Music plays on its own after the queued tracks: status and up to 5
suggestions. Absent when the page state was not readable.

preferences.description:
The recorded tastes, sent on this client's first prompt and whenever they changed since
its previous one; empty when `preferences_unchanged` or `preferences_unavailable`.

preferencesTotal.description: Total recorded tastes on the account when available (more than `preferences.len()` when paged).

preferencesUnavailable.description: True when the player could not read stored tastes for this prompt; keep earlier known tastes.

preferencesUnchanged.description: The tastes are the same as in this client's previous prompt.

upcoming.description:
Whether `up_next` is what follows the current occurrence. When unknown it is empty and
says nothing about what comes next.

lastReceived.description:
The last prompt this client actually received. A prompt handed out after it (for
example to a wait the client cancelled before the reply arrived) is offered again, so a
cancelled wait loses nothing; the client skips repeats by `(coreEpoch, seq)`. Ignored
when it names another core epoch.

spoke.description: The agent said something to the listener since its previous call.

userSpoke.description: The listener talked to the agent since its previous call.

oneOf.description: The current track is about to end.
A good moment to ask the listener whether the music still suits them.

The listener just did something by hand that says where the music should go (see the
reasons). It is a chance to adjust what plays next, not a prompt to speak.
The listener has not done or said anything for a while.
The current track is long.
Nothing in particular; it has simply been a while.
At most one track is queued after the current one.
The listener skipped two or more tracks in a row.
The listener started something particular by hand: a track, a collection, a queue entry.
The listener went back to hear a track again, or turned on repeat-one.
The listener chose another Up Next filter.
Kept for the account until cleared; replaces an earlier entry for the same subject.

DjFeedbackTarget.description: What a feedback entry is about.

oneOf.description: A command from the player window, media keys or MPRIS.
The agent reported that the listener talked to it.

actionsOmitted.description: Older actions since the previous prompt that are not listed.

lastSpokenToAgoMs.description: When the agent last reported speaking to the listener.

recentActions.description:
What the listener did by hand since this client's previous prompt, newest first, at most
[`crate::MAX_LISTENER_ACTIONS`]. Facts for the agent to read; never a request.

unansweredCheckIns.description:
Unanswered check-ins in a row: each check-in that comes with no listener action or words
since the previous check-in adds one, and any listener action or words reset it. The
first check-in after a reset counts 0. Above zero, check-ins come less often.

DjOfficialUpNext.description: YouTube Music's own continuation in a prompt.

filter.description: The selected Up Next filter's label, when one is offered.

more.description: More suggestions are loaded than listed.

DjPreference.description: One recorded DJ preference of the current account.

recordedBy.description: The registered client that recorded it; not a claim about a human.

DjTrack.description: The few track facts a DJ prompt needs; the music tools return the full track.

oneOf.description: Ended early without a command the player could attribute.

capturedAtMs.description:
The instant `time` describes (Unix ms), so an assistant can turn "tonight" or "for two
hours" into an absolute `expiresAtMs`. Present only with `time`.

weatherProvided.description: Always false: the player never fetches weather; an assistant may look it up for `sceneCity`.

InterruptResumePolicy.description: What follows an immediate interruption once the inserted tracks have played.

oneOf.description: Replay the interrupted track from its saved position, then the original upcoming queue.
Continue with the original upcoming queue; the interrupted track is not replayed.
Start a new playback context from the inserted tracks; nothing is restored.
The policy does not restore anything.
The inserted tracks are playing; the interrupted track has not been resumed yet.
The replay occurrence started and the saved position was observed.
Manual control, a divergent queue, cancellation, expiry or a restart ended the plan.

ListenerAction.description:
Something the listener did by hand: in the player window, from the tray, with media keys or
through MPRIS. Commands sent by any agent are never listed.

during.description: What was playing when they acted, and where in it.

seekToMs.description: Where a seek landed. A drag is one action.

subject.description:
The track the action was about (picked, queued, rated): the playing one when it was about
that. Absent for actions with no track of their own, and while the player cannot name the
track yet (for example one just picked from search).

value.description:
The new setting in plain words: `on` or `off`, a repeat mode, a rating (`liked`,
`disliked`, `neutral`), or the label of the chosen Up Next filter.

volumeFrom.description: Volume before and after, 0 to 100. A drag is one action from its first to its last value.

oneOf.description: Skipped to the next track.
Went back: to the previous track, or to the start of this one.
Started a particular track.
Started an album, playlist or other collection.
Jumped to an entry of the queue.
Chose an Up Next filter.
Liked, disliked or cleared a rating in the app.

ListenerProfile.description:
A compact picture of the signed-in listener's own music, built only from their library and
play history. Every part says how much it was built from; a part that could not be read is
named in `unavailable` and is not an empty result.

history.description: Plays recorded by this player on this machine.

scripts.description:
The writing systems of the titles and artist names in the sampled liked songs and plays,
largest first. A track counts once, under the script of most of its letters. It describes
what the listener listens to; it is not their language, country or interface language.

scriptsSampled.description: Tracks the script figures were counted over.

tasteNotes.description: Taste notes stored for this account (read them with the DJ prompt or the taste tools).

unavailable.description: Parts that could not be read this time: `liked`, `history`, `playlists`, `tasteNotes`.

ListenerProfileInput.description: Input of a listener profile read.

refresh.description: Read the library again instead of using the copy kept for this session.

oneOf.description:
`expected_moment_revision` is the Moment revision the change was decided on. An
inference must carry it; a listener's request may omit it.

Clears the intent stored under `intent_key`. With `intent_id`, only that exact intent:
one that replaced it since it was read stays.

ListeningIntentInstruction.description: One session-scoped listening intent dimension. Updating a dimension replaces only that dimension.

LocalHistoryRange.description: The local recording timestamp is known. YouTube history may only have a period label.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone identifier from the local device clock.

MomentView.description: Authoritative Moment DJ context projection delivered to one authorized MCP client.

oneOf.description: Autoplay is on and suggestions are loaded: `tracks` play after the explicit list.
Autoplay is on, nothing is loaded yet and the page is fetching suggestions.
Autoplay is off: suggestions the page still holds will not play, so none are listed.
The queue is a radio that refills itself; its own entries are what plays next.
Autoplay is on but no suggestions are loaded or being fetched.

OfficialUpcomingView.description: The page's own continuation after the explicit list.

more.description: More suggestions are loaded than listed here.

status.description:
`observed` (tracks follow the explicit list), `loading`, `off` (autoplay is off: nothing
plays after the list), `radio` (the queue refills itself) or `none`.

tracks.description: Suggestions in play order; only for `observed`.

removed.description: What a removal took away, recorded before anything is sent, so it can be restored.

oneOf.description: A request for the user to sign in, renew or switch the account in the player.
Saved resume plan of an immediate interruption, updated as playback progresses.

resumeEntryId.description: The queued replay occurrence of the interrupted track, once it is verified.

resumePositionMs.description: Playback position captured right before the switch, when the policy resumes it.

PlaybackContext.description: Playlist identity and index read from the official page's selected native queue item.

oneOf.description:
Selects an Up Next filter (`queueFilterId`): replaces only YouTube Music's own
suggestions, without interrupting the current track. Observed once the snapshot shows
that filter selected.

ProfileSample.description: One source of the profile: how much of it was read, who appears most, and its newest tracks.

recent.description: The newest sampled tracks, newest first.

sampled.description: Tracks actually read for this profile.

topArtists.description: Artists with the most sampled tracks, most first.

total.description: Tracks in the source as a whole, when the source says.

QueueEntryId.description: Occurrence-scoped queue entry identifier within a bridge epoch.

QueueFilterView.description: One Up Next filter the page shows.

filterId.description:
Pass to the `upNextFilter` playback mode. It names this filter for the suggestions
offered when it was read: after the listener changes songs or the suggestions change
seed, an old id is refused; read the context again then.

filters.description:
The Up Next filters the page offers now (label and whether selected). Empty when none
are offered or they could not be read.

officialUpcoming.description:
YouTube Music's own continuation after the explicit list (autoplay suggestions, or a
radio that refills itself). Read-only: these tracks are not occurrences and cannot be
selected or edited. Absent when the page state was not readable.

upcoming.description:
Whether the current occurrence is in the loaded window. When it is not, nothing is known
about what follows it: a context read then carries no entries, and a queue read pages the
loaded window without a position.

RemovedItem.description: One entry a removal took (or, while unsettled, may have taken) from the account or device.

oneOf.description: A playlist occurrence and its zero-based position in the playlist before the removal.
A local playback history entry and when it was recorded.

ReportedIntentBasis.description: Provenance accepted from external MCP clients (owners set `ownerInput` strictly from desktop UI).

Script.description: A writing system, as told from the letters of a title and its artist names.

oneOf.description: Chinese characters without kana: Chinese, or Japanese written only in kanji.
Japanese kana, with or without kanji.
Another script, or no letters at all.

ShareAccess.description: Access evidence for an individual recipient remains unknown.

TrackInstanceId.description: Unique playback instance identifier (distinguishes repeated plays).

UiLanguage.description: The language the UI is shown in. Values are the UI's BCP 47 locale tags.

UpcomingStatus.description: Whether what follows the current occurrence is known.

oneOf.description: The current occurrence is in the loaded window; entries after it are what follows.
The current occurrence is not in the loaded window.

Selects an Up Next filter read from the context (`filters[].filterId`). It replaces only
YouTube Music's own suggestions after the queued tracks; the current track keeps playing
and tracks the listener queued stay.
Remove the nearest loaded upcoming occurrences, at most 50; partial when more may follow.
Clear the upcoming occurrences best effort, then insert in input order.
Switch to the inserted tracks now and follow the explicit resume policy afterwards.
A struct variant: the edit carries its own `kind` tag inside `edit`.
Asks the user, without opening or focusing any window, to change the account.
